passages.question: Does every employee line carry a SOC code ESD accepts?
passages.excerpt: Provide a SOC code or job title for each employee in your unemployment tax report to avoid a penalty. This requirement started with reports filed for Quarter 1 of 2024. ... The code will be 6 digits. ... Valid SOC codes do not end in a zero. ESD accepts only SOC codes that end in 1 through 9. ... You cannot change SOC codes once you file.
